rituals.title: THE TWO-TRAY TEST
rituals.name: THE TWO-TRAY TEST
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER

PATTERN

PLAY TIME

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
HOOK
The Two-Tray Test is the moment where stuck thinking stops being the boss.

MISSION
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

GAME MOVE
Use the game exactly once: imagine trays opens it, balance verdict ends it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
🎮 THE TWO-TRAY TEST // PLAY
Use the sequence as written: imagine trays opens, balance verdict closes.

1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same.

⚡ FINISH MOVE — End with balance verdict; the game owes no certainty in The Two-Tray Test.

The Two-Tray Test lands when the next response outruns stuck thinking.

✨ LOCK IT IN
